name: project-orchestrator
description: Autonomous planning and multi-subtask orchestration for large projects: analyze the project, decompose tasks, dispatch parallel/serial subtask conversations by dependency, monitor progress on a kanban board, downgrade simple subtasks to a lighter model to save credits, and summarize deliverables when done.
author: Alicifia
skillInstructions: When the user asks to autonomously plan and complete a large project, decompose it into subtasks executed in parallel/serial, monitor subtask progress, or aggregate subtask deliverables, load the project-orchestrator skill and strictly follow its P0-P5 phase workflow.
